user.title: Add a V-Guard device
user.description: The inverter or water heater must be connected to the same MQTT broker as Home Assistant. See the README for the DNS redirect it needs.

pick_device.title: Choose a device
pick_device.description: Found {device_count} device(s) on the MQTT broker. A water heater only shows up while it's switched on.

key.title: Water heater encryption key
key.description: Some V-Guard water heaters may encrypt their readings. Leave both fields empty unless the heater's readings stay empty.

data_description.key: The 16-character key the V-Guard app received for this heater.
data_description.iv: The 16-character IV that comes with the key.

manual.title: Enter the device's details
manual.description: The serial number is the last part of the device's MQTT topic, after `device/dups/CE01/` for an inverter or `device/smartewh/3013/` for a water heater.

data_description.model: The part of the topic before the serial number. Leave empty for CE01 (inverter) or 3013 (water heater).
data_description.key: Water heaters only. Leave empty unless the heater ignores commands. The 16-character key the V-Guard app received for this heater.
data_description.iv: Water heaters only. The 16-character IV that comes with the key.

progress.discovering: Listening for V-Guard devices on MQTT…

error.no_devices_found: No new V-Guard devices were heard on MQTT. Check the DNS redirect, switch the water heater on, or enter the serial number.
error.invalid_serial: Serial number and model code may only contain letters and digits.
error.invalid_key: The key and IV must both be 16 characters, or both be left empty.

abort.already_configured: This device is already set up.
abort.mqtt_not_ready: Set up the MQTT integration first. V-Guard devices talk to Home Assistant through it.
